purpose: Flag possible direct or quasi-identifiers left after first-pass de-identification.
flag: specific street addresses, postal codes, phone numbers, email addresses, or account identifiers
specific dates tied to an identifiable encounter when not already redacted
specific facilities, villages, or employers when they materially narrow identity
do_not_flag: conditions, symptoms, medications, laboratory values, or treatment plans
generic phrases such as hospital, clinic, or doctor
guessed identifiers that are not explicitly present in the note
output_rules: Quote only exact substrings present in the redacted note.
Use an empty findings list if no likely remaining identifier is explicit.
Do not provide medical advice or rewrite the note.
